mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM derived_facts d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (d.subject_id IN (#{a}, #{b}) OR d.object_id IN (#{a}, #{b}))

SELECT count(*) FROM conversation_messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.role = 'assistant' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.resolved) e WHERE e->>'id' IN (#{a}, #{b}))
SELECT count(DISTINCT d.id) FROM fact_derivations fd JOIN derived_facts d ON d.id = fd.derived_fact_id WHERE fd.premise_fact_id = #{factId} AND d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.invalidated_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM conversation_messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.role = 'assistant' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.resolved) e WHERE e->>'id' = (SELECT subject_id::text FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}))

SELECT r.label FROM relation_types r WHERE r.id = #{predicateId} AND r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.functional AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND f.predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL AND f.object_id <> #{object} AND f.id IS DISTINCT FROM #{replacing})
